يفتلوا (form VIII)
# يَفْتَلُوا (yaftalū) /jaf.ta.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَلَى (iftalā)
# يُفْتَلَوْا (yuftalaw) /juf.ta.law/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَلَى (iftalā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
